evals.prompt: Upgrade our React app to Fetcher 6. package.json has @ahoo-wang/fetcher, @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react and @ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow 5.1.2, and src/orders/OrderTable.tsx imports { useFetcher, usePagedQuery } from '@ahoo-wang/fetcher-react'.
evals.expected_output: Runs `npm view @ahoo-wang/wow-client version` (and the fetcher dist-tags) before proposing installs. If the Wow packages are not published, recommends staying on 5.x, pinning 5.1.3, and lists what will change later; it does not add @ahoo-wang/wow-* to package.json. If they are published, moves fetcher-react to 5.1.3, replaces fetcher-wow with wow-client and imports usePagedQuery from @ahoo-wang/wow-react while useFetcher stays in @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react, then bumps fetcher packages to ^6.

evals.prompt: After bumping @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react to 6.0.0, TypeScript says Module '"@ahoo-wang/fetcher-react"' has no exported member 'useDataMonitor'. How do I fix it?
evals.expected_output: Explains the data-monitor hooks (useDataMonitor, DataMonitorService, dataMonitorEventBus, DataChangedEvent, …) were removed in 6.0 with no replacement; the options are to delete the calls and the UI built on them, or keep every @ahoo-wang/fetcher* package on 5.x (^5.1.3). Does not invent a replacement package.

evals.prompt: Our package.json has "generate": "fetcher-generator generate -i http://localhost:8080/v3/api-docs -o src/generated" and src/generated imports from @ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow. What changes for Fetcher 6?
evals.expected_output: States @ahoo-wang/fetcher-generator became @ahoo-wang/wow-generator (command wow-generator; fetcher-generator remains an alias until Wow v10), that it is not on npm yet so the check comes first, and that generated code must be regenerated (it then imports @ahoo-wang/wow-client) or have its @ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow import rewritten; ends with a type-check of src/generated.

evals.prompt: Give me a checklist of grep commands to find everything in this repo that blocks an upgrade from fetcher 5 to 6.
evals.expected_output: Grep patterns for manifests/lockfiles (fetcher-wow, fetcher-generator, fetcher-viewer), imports of the moved packages, the Wow query hooks (use(Fetcher)?(Single|List|Paged|Count|ListStream)Query and their Options/Return types) without matching useFetcherQuery, the data-monitor symbols, and the fetcher-generator command in scripts/CI; each hit mapped to stay-on-5.x or rewrite.

evals.prompt: Set up a NamedFetcher with a 5s timeout and a bearer-token interceptor for our new service on Fetcher 6.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT use this skill: nothing is being migrated. $fetcher-integration handles new client setup (NamedFetcher, interceptors, timeout).
